messages:
Alex R.: Uploading initial mapping for CoralBank SIG Q — attaching evidence_index.csv and coralbank_screenshots.zip. Ping if you see gaps.

doc-bot: uploaded files: evidence_index.csv, coralbank_screenshots.zip, network-diagram-v1.pdf

Priya P.: Thanks — quick q: for Q12 (encryption of data in transit) do we have cert export or just config screenshots?

Alex R.: We have both. cert export (redacted) and screenshots. cert export path (internal): s3://redwood-sec/coralbank/certs.pem — I'll add a redacted PEM to the zip.

Samir K.: Need HSM/KMS key rotation proof for Q28. Do they want rotation policy + proof of events (last 6 months) or just the policy? Also need an owner/contact.

Jenna S.: I spoke with their security contact Erin L. — they want the policy + last 6 months of rotation event logs. Erin will upload logs to our secure upload tomorrow.

Priya P.: :thumbsup: For Q45 (network segmentation) can you attach the VPC peering diagram + the subnet ACL snippet? I can redact IPs.

Alex R.: Added network-diagram-v1.pdf and subnet-acl.txt to the zip. subnet-acl includes a small snippet; ping me if you want the full terraform.

Samir K.: Also please map SOC2 controls -> SIG questions. If we include `SOC2_mapping.xlsx` that makes reviewers happy. Priya, can you run that mapping?

Priya P.: On it — will push SOC2_mapping.xlsx to the same folder and update evidence_index.csv with question->artifact links.

Alex R.: One more note from the buyer: they asked about Private deployment (VPC/on-prem). Adding a one-paragraph note in the pack: ‘Private control plane option available; see docs/cloud/onprem.pdf’ and a short diagram.

doc-bot: folder link: https://uploads.internal/redwood/coralbank/sig-pack-1719876543 — access restricted to @sales, @security

Jenna S.: Action items: Alex — upload the redacted cert & updated zip by EOD; Priya — finish SOC2 mapping; Samir — confirm HSM log sample. I'll follow up with Erin for the secure upload link.

Samir K.: Security note: if any artifacts contain production secrets, label them as `sensitive` in the index and we'll route through secure-vault. Do NOT include full private keys in the pack.

Alex R.: Acknowledged. Redacted cert uploaded, zip updated. evidence_index.csv sample rows: ```question_id,artifact_name,artifact_path,sensitive
Q12,cert-export,coralbank/certs_redacted.pem,false
Q28,kms-rotation,kms_rotation_events_2025-10-01.csv,true
Q45,network-diagram,network-diagram-v1.pdf,false```

Priya P.: :rocket: Great — I'll update mapping and ping when `SOC2_mapping.xlsx` is in. Thanks team!
